 MANILA: Philippine Airlines (PAL) has announced the cancellation or rescheduling of several domestic and international flights to and from Manila from Nov. 14 to 18 amid the arrival of delegates to the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in Manila.
 In an advisory posted on its website on Oct. 30, PAL said affected passengers would be notified through email and SMS. They may also avail themselves of free rebooking, a full refund, or conversion to a travel fund through the airline’s website.
 The 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits will run from Nov. 10 to 12, with some related events extending through Nov. 15. The gatherings are expected to bring together leaders from Southeast Asia and other countries.
 President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. earlier declared Nov. 16 to 18 as special (non-working) days in the National Capital Region in anticipation of the summit.
